title: Polyphyllin B inhibited STAT3/NCOA4 pathway and restored gut microbiota to ameliorate lung tissue injury in cigarette smoke-induced mice.
authors: Wang, Qing; He, Zhiyi; Zhu, Jinqi; Hu, Mengyun; Yang, Liu; Yang, Hongzhong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Polyphyllin B通过STAT3/NCOA4通路和肠道菌群改善香烟烟雾诱导的肺损伤，仅用分子对接初步分析STAT3结合，核心是湿实验和药理机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Smoking was a major risk factor for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). This study plan to explore the mechanism of Polyphyllin B in lung injury induced by cigarette smoke (CSE) in COPD. METHODS: Network pharmacology and molecular docking were applied to analyze the potential binding targets for Polyphyllin B and COPD. Commercial unfiltered CSE and LPS were used to construct BEAS-2B cell injury in vitro and COPD mouse models in vivo, respectively, which were treated with Polyphyllin B or fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT). CCK8, LDH and calcein-AM were used to detect the cell proliferation, LDH level and labile iron pool. Lung histopathology, Fe(3+) deposition and mitochondrial morphology were observed by hematoxylin-eosin, Prussian blue staining and transmission electron microscope, respectively. ELISA was used to measure inflammation and oxidative stress levels in cells and lung tissues. Immunohistochemistry and immunofluorescence were applied to analyze the 4-HNE, LC3 and Ferritin expression. RT-qPCR was used to detect the expression of FcRn, pIgR, STAT3 and NCOA4. Western blot was used to detect the expression of Ferritin, p-STAT3/STAT3, NCOA4, GPX4, TLR2, TLR4 and P65 proteins. 16S rRNA gene sequencing was applied to detect the gut microbiota. RESULTS: Polyphyllin B had a good binding affinity with STAT3 protein, which as a target gene in COPD. Polyphyllin B inhibited CS-induced oxidative stress, inflammation, mitochondrial damage, and ferritinophagy in COPD mice. 16S rRNA sequencing and FMT confirmed that Akkermansia and Escherichia_Shigella might be the potential microbiota for Polyphyllin B and FMT to improve CSE and LPS-induced COPD, which were exhausted by the antibiotics in C + L and C + L + P mice. CSE and LPS induced the decrease of cell viability and the ferritin and LC3 expression, and the increase of NCOA4 and p-STAT3 expression in BEAS-2B cells, which were inhibited by Polyphyllin B. Polyphyllin B promoted ferritin and LC3II/I expression, and inhibited p-STAT3 and NCOA4 expression in CSE + LPS-induced BEAS-2B cells. CONCLUSION: Polyphyllin B improved gut microbiota disorder and inhibited STAT3/NCOA4 pathway to ameliorate lung tissue injury in CSE and LPS-induced mice.
abstract_zh: 目的：吸烟是慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）的主要危险因素。本研究计划探讨重楼皂苷B在香烟烟雾提取物（CSE）诱导的COPD肺损伤中的作用机制。方法：采用网络药理学和分子对接分析重楼皂苷B与COPD的潜在结合靶点。分别使用商业无过滤CSE和LPS构建体外BEAS-2B细胞损伤模型和体内COPD小鼠模型，并用重楼皂苷B或粪菌移植（FMT）进行处理。采用CCK8、LDH和calcein-AM检测细胞增殖、LDH水平和不稳定铁池。通过苏木精-伊红染色、普鲁士蓝染色和透射电子显微镜分别观察肺组织病理学、Fe(3+)沉积和线粒体形态。采用ELISA检测细胞和肺组织中的炎症及氧化应激水平。采用免疫组织化学和免疫荧光分析4-HNE、LC3和铁蛋白表达。采用RT-qPCR检测FcRn、pIgR、STAT3和NCOA4的表达。采用Western blot检测铁蛋白、p-STAT3/STAT3、NCOA4、GPX4、TLR2、TLR4和P65蛋白的表达。采用16S rRNA基因测序检测肠道菌群。结果：重楼皂苷B与STAT3蛋白具有良好的结合亲和力，STAT3是COPD中的靶基因。重楼皂苷B抑制了COPD小鼠中CS诱导的氧化应激、炎症、线粒体损伤和铁蛋白自噬。16S rRNA测序和FMT证实，Akkermansia和Escherichia_Shigella可能是重楼皂苷B和FMT改善CSE和LPS诱导的COPD的潜在菌群，这些菌群在C+L和C+L+P小鼠中因抗生素处理而耗竭。CSE和LPS诱导BEAS-2B细胞活力下降、铁蛋白和LC3表达降低，以及NCOA4和p-STAT3表达升高，而重楼皂苷B抑制了这些变化。重楼皂苷B促进了CSE+LPS诱导的BEAS-2B细胞中铁蛋白和LC3II/I的表达，并抑制了p-STAT3和NCOA4的表达。结论：重楼皂苷B改善肠道菌群紊乱并抑制STAT3/NCOA4通路，从而减轻CSE和LPS诱导小鼠的肺组织损伤。
